name: Advanced Baseline Imager Level 2 - Rainfall Rate Quantitative Precipitation Estimate
description: Estimates instantaneous rainfall rate in mm hr⁻¹ using a multi-channel ABI algorithm that combines visible, near-infrared, and infrared channels. The product provides quantitative precipitation estimates at high temporal frequency to support hydrology, flash flood guidance, and disaster response.
